AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveCoefficientBounds.bounded_measurable_coefficient_along_progressive_process.{u_1,
    u_2}
  {Ω : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [TopologicalSpace S] [TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace S]
  [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S] {filtration : MeasureTheory.Filtration NNReal inferInstance}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (X : NNReal → Ω → S)
  (hX : Measurable (Function.uncurry X)) (hProgressive : MeasureTheory.IsStronglyProgressive filtration X)
  (c : NNReal × S → ℝ) (hc : Measurable c) (T : NNReal) (p : ENNReal)
  (hBound : ∃ C, ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ (x : S), ‖c (t, x)‖ ≤ C) :
  have b := fun t ω => c (t, X t ω);
  MeasureTheory.IsStronglyProgressive filtration b ∧
    (∀ (ω : Ω),
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => b t ω)
          (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T)) ∧
      MeasureTheory.MemLp (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.processFunction b) p
        (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ElementaryItoIntegral.processTimeMeasure μ T)

def MeasureTheory.IsStronglyProgressive.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : {Ω : Type u_1} →
  {ι : Type u_2} →
    {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} →
      [inst : Preorder ι] →
        {β : Type u_3} →
          [TopologicalSpace β] → [MeasurableSpace ι] → @MeasureTheory.Filtration Ω ι inst m → (ι → Ω → β) → Prop :=
fun {Ω} {ι} {m} [inst : Preorder ι] {β} [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace ι] f u =>
  ∀ (i : ι),
    @MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable
      (Prod (@Subtype ι fun x => @Membership.mem ι (Set ι) (@Set.instMembership ι) (@Set.Iic ι inst i) x) Ω) β inst_1
      (@MeasurableSpace.prod
        (@Subtype ι fun x => @Membership.mem ι (Set ι) (@Set.instMembership ι) (@Set.Iic ι inst i) x) Ω
        (@Subtype.instMeasurableSpace ι
          (fun x => @Membership.mem ι (Set ι) (@Set.instMembership ι) (@Set.Iic ι inst i) x) inst_2)
        (@MeasureTheory.Filtration.seq Ω ι inst m f i))
      fun p =>
      u
        (@Subtype.val ι (fun x => @Membership.mem ι (Set ι) (@Set.instMembership ι) (@Set.Iic ι inst i) x)
          (@Prod.fst (@Set.Elem ι (@Set.Iic ι inst i)) Ω p))
        (@Prod.snd (@Set.Elem ι (@Set.Iic ι inst i)) Ω p)

def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.processFunction.{u_1} : {Omega : Type u_1} →
  (NNReal → Omega → ℝ) → Omega × NNReal → ℝ :=
fun {Omega} eta z => eta z.2 z.1
def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ElementaryItoIntegral.processTimeMeasure.{u_1} : {Omega :
    Type u_1} →
  [inst : MeasurableSpace Omega] → MeasureTheory.Measure Omega → NNReal → MeasureTheory.Measure (Omega × NNReal) :=
fun {Omega} [MeasurableSpace Omega] mu T =>
  mu.prod (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T)
def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo : NNReal → MeasureTheory.Measure NNReal :=
fun T => MeasureTheory.Measure.comap NNReal.toReal (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 ↑T))
